# Renewably

> Renewably gives solar PV installers in Ireland an AI-powered workforce:
> specialist AI agents that run the front and back office of a solar
> installation business, from answering enquiries and following up leads to
> coordinating installs, handling grant paperwork and reporting. It is a
> founder-led, managed service, not self-serve software. The installer keeps
> their existing CRM and tools; Renewably works alongside them. Week one runs
> in approval mode, and the first message to anyone new always needs the
> owner's yes.

## What Renewably does
- Answers and follows up customer enquiries quickly, in the installer's own voice
- Qualifies leads and books the right next conversation
- Coordinates installs, materials and scheduling
- Handles SEAI grant applications and tracks ESB Networks paperwork
- Gives the owner a clear operating view and escalates decisions to a human
- Never contacts anyone new without the owner's approval; in week one, every message is owner-approved

## Who it is for
Solar PV installation businesses in Ireland (SEAI-registered installers) with
steady job volume who want to move faster without hiring more admin staff.

## How it works
A short call scopes the business; Renewably then builds and configures the
agent team over one to two weeks, with the owner approving every step. Most
engagements start with a two-role front office (a PA that handles sending and
follow-up, and a Chief of Staff that decides and drafts) and grow into the
full workforce as the owner approves each new hire. Pricing is a monthly
service with no lock-in. Installers bring their own AI provider keys and pay
model usage directly, with no markup.
